entry.title: Pharrell and Pusha T: Growing Up, Grindin and Dreaming Big | Vogue

media:group.media:title: Pharrell and Pusha T: Growing Up, Grindin and Dreaming Big | Vogue
media:group.media:description:
Hip-hop superstars Pharrell Williams and Pusha T sit down together for an in-depth conversation about their shared history, decades of friendship, and creative partnership. The two reflect on growing up together in Virginia, watching MTV and learning from the artists who inspired them, and the early days of their musical careers. Pharrell and Pusha also look back on collaborating on Clipse records, open up about their creative disagreements, and reveal what it's like getting to work together at 5 a.m. The longtime collaborators also discuss their latest venture, Grindin, and how their shared passion for creativity has carried over into the coffee business.

Is it harder for Jenna to play Wednesday’s deadpan delivery or Klara’s curiosity? Who would last longer in a horror film? Who would win in a dance-off? Ball gown or trouser suit? Sunrise or sunset? entry.title: Inside LeBron and Savannah James's Home, Full of Wonderful Objects | Vogue

media:group.media:title: Inside LeBron and Savannah James's Home, Full of Wonderful Objects | Vogue
media:group.media:description:
LeBron James and Savannah James take us inside their lovely Los Angeles home and show us some of their most prized possessions. Savannah James, who co-hosts the hit podcast "Everybody's Crazy" with best friend April McDaniel, and the 76ers superstar start off with LeBron’s Vitaeris hyperbaric chamber that he uses for recovery. While Savannah claims it’s “too small," the six-foot-nine LeBron has no issue squeezing in for some all-important restoration. Next, the family moves on to LeBron’s four NBA championships with three different teams: the Lakers, Cavaliers, and Miami Heat. Savannah then proceeds to show us a skeletonized Cartier Crash that she gifted LeBron for their anniversary, as well as some comfy UGG x Palace slides that she uses for travel. The James family ends the tour by showcasing their white LeBron James Edition Mercedes-Maybach, a fully decked-out luxury car that’s one of two, with the other being auctioned off to benefit the LeBron James Family Foundation.
